named-query.name: si.laurentius.msh.inbox.event.MSHInEvent.getMailEventList
named-query.query: select p from MSHInEvent p where p.mailId = :mailId order by p.id asc

named-native-query.name: si.laurentius.msh.inbox.event.MSHInEvent.getList
named-native-query.query: SELECT ev.id, ev.mail_id, ev.status, ev.date, ev.description, ev.user_id, ev.application_id FROM lau_inbox_event ev, lau_inbox im WHERE ev.mail_id = im.id and im.receiver_ebox = :receiverEBox and (ev.mail_id = :mailId or :mailId is null) order by id desc
